why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.68 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 23.5 points of that tide, a tailwind for Troy Carter.

D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Troy Carter leads by 64.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 166,747 votes; a one point swing is about 1,288 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +57.8 and D +71.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.2 points away from Troy Carter. Election Day has to make it up: the remaining vote must break harder your way than the forecast expects.
